newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - HK Newspaper Headlines - July 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - HK Newspaper Headlines - July 2.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Hong Kong press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Front page coverage in all papers was dominated by the Hong Kong's historic transition to Beijing rule.
-- APPLE DAILY: Indonesia withdrew visa-free entry for Hong Kong British National (Overseas) (BNO) passport holders, and Cathay Pacific barred five passengers from boarding its flight to Jakarta.
Across both sides of Hong Kong's harbour, about 900,000 people turned out to watch the extravaganza of laser and fireworks to celebrate the region's return to Chinese rule.
-- SING TAO: China's president Jiang Zemin does not allow provincial governments to interfere with Hong Kong's affairs, and promises to progressively develop democracy.
-- MING PO: Chief executive Tung Chee-hwa's blueprint for Hong Kong includes building 85,000 flats each year and stamp out property speculation.
-- SING PO: China's central state departments will not have direct command lines with Hong Kong's administration.
